estimand.unit: one treatment-blind maintenance task from one canonical public GitHub repository
estimand.target_population: eligible TypeScript Next.js maintenance records frozen before task authoring
estimand.development_partition_use: measurement development only; excluded from confirmatory inference
estimand.safety_control_use: unchanged-rule non-inferiority and critical-failure gates; never pooled into the primary outcome

repository: The repository is public, non-archived, non-fork, and has an OSI-identifiable license at the frozen source commit.
The exact source commit and tree are reachable from the canonical HTTPS GitHub repository at the selection cutoff.
A frozen package.json and dependency lock prove the React and Next.js declarations and resolved dependency graph, and at least one task target is TypeScript or TSX.
The source can be archived during trusted preparation without submodules, unsafe links, secret-bearing paths, generated dependency trees, or network-dependent trial setup.
A repository may contribute at most one task across development, target holdout, and safety-control partitions.
maintenance_record: The record is a public issue, pull request, or commit belonging to the selected repository and predating task authoring.
The record supplies a concrete Server Action authorization, RSC serialization, DOM batching, large-array, hook-timing, or event-handler maintenance concern.
The base source predates the repair; a public executable regression test and a separately held host verifier both fail on base and pass on a frozen gold tree during trusted preparation.
The record snapshot and eligibility decision have immutable SHA-256 digests and do not expose the private expected patch to the Agent.
task: The public task is treatment-blind and asks for an implementation in the frozen read-only archive plus an isolated writable worktree.
The task requires no clone, fetch, install, download, build-image, mutable reference resolution, or external network access during the Agent trial.
The public executable test is present in the source manifest; the host verifier and expected values remain outside the Agent archive in a mode-0600 private bundle.
Outcome, safety, and mechanism dimensions are declared independently. Opening a rule is mechanism evidence and cannot make an incorrect implementation pass.

sampling.population_snapshot: Freeze every eligible record, source identity, stack evidence, and eligibility decision before selecting or authoring tasks.
sampling.selection_seed: Freeze one unpredictable 256-bit seed before inspecting treatment outputs.
sampling.algorithm: Within each partition and stratum, sort eligible records by SHA256(seed + newline + canonical lower-case repository URL + newline + public record URL + newline), then select the first quota while enforcing one repository cluster globally.
sampling.replacement: If a selected record fails source preparation or base-fail/gold-pass qualification, retain its exact failure receipt and take the next record in the precomputed order; never hand-pick a replacement.

preparation.boundary: All GitHub reads, source archiving, license and stack checks, regression-test qualification, host-verifier qualification, and digest generation occur in trusted setup --prepare before preview approval.
trial_restrictions: No clone, fetch, install, download, image build or pull, Docker-socket access, or mutable reference resolution is permitted in an Agent trial.
Each trial receives one digest-verified source archive and public test plus a writable overlay; the source population and labels are never mounted.
Private labels and host verifiers remain mode 0600 on the host; only their digests and derived scores may enter snapshots and results.
required_receipts: population query, eligibility-decision, and deterministic-selection receipts
remote commit/tree, public-record snapshot, package-manifest, dependency-lock, TypeScript target, and license receipts per selected repository
source archive and file-manifest digests per selected repository
public executable test and host-only verifier digests per task
base-fail/gold-pass receipts for both the public test and host verifier in the pinned verifier runtime
public-task and host-only private-label manifest digests

sealing.development: Development tasks may be opened only after their separate preview is approved; they do not license holdout access.
sealing.holdout: Target holdouts and safety controls are sealed before development outputs are inspected and receive a separate preview, approval, budget, and execution identity.
sealing.contamination: Exposure of a holdout prompt, verifier, expected value, repair commit, or repository cluster before holdout execution invalidates that task and invokes deterministic replacement.
sealing.approval: Every Study requires an exact finite preview. This protocol authorizes no execution or spend.

analysis_constraints: Attempts estimate repeatability but do not increase the number of independent repository clusters.
The primary analysis clusters by canonical repository and uses only the 192 target holdouts.
The two intended changed-rule families are primary outcomes; four unchanged-rule families are separate safety controls.
Deterministic outcome, safety, mechanism, qualitative-judge, and efficiency evidence remain separate.
A prospective power simulation over the completed frozen frame is required before holdout preview approval.
A same-model-family judge remains advisory until an independent reviewed validation satisfies its declared gate.

readiness.fail_closed: No development or holdout spec, source lock, task archive, or paid preview may be generated until the complete 288-cluster bundle validates.
